items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME: Left 4 Dead 2-style co-op FPS. I am player 'Hengyuhan'; bot teammates are Coach (purple shirt, khaki pants), Ellis and Rochelle. Crosshair is at screen center.

CONTROLS (observed):
- W/A/S/D move/strafe. Short strafes work well for fine horizontal aim; movement is slow at low health.
- Arrow keys Left/Right turn at about 200 deg/s (a 0.05s tap is about 25 deg). Use arrows to turn, since mouse dx turns very little.
- Mouse dy is INVERTED: positive looks up, negative looks down. About -180 dy moves the view roughly 0.15 of the screen height. Up/Down arrow keys did not pitch the view.
- E picks up items when the crosshair is on them: a prompt 'E <item>' or a reaching-hand animation appears. E also revives (hold).
- J fires, K shoves (shove is safe for teammates and pushes Boomers and crowds back), R reloads.
- Number keys select slots: 2 secondary, 3 throwable, 4 medkit.
- Healing: select slot 4 and hold J. Holding J for 3s did NOT finish a self-heal (it was interrupted or too short; the prompt greyed out). A self-heal likely needs longer than 3s, and my action holds max out around 3s. Bots healed me once earlier (health 24 to 84).

MECHANICS OBSERVED:
- Boomer bile blinds the screen and attracts a horde. Shoot Boomers from range.
- Spitter acid (green puddles) drains health fast, so avoid it.
- Special infected seen so far: Hunter, Jockey, Smoker, Charger, Spitter, Boomer. Bots mostly kill them.
- Downed survivors can only wait for a revive. Hint icons with arrows point toward items, teammates or objectives.
- Teammates show name labels or silhouettes; wait for a label before firing, because I once nearly shot Rochelle and got a 'Don't shoot teammates!' warning.

NAVIGATION SO FAR:
- Start on the rooftop and pick up a medkit from the table by the roof door.
- Go through the ROOF ACCESS door into a switchback stairwell and descend; going up loops back to the roof.
- Lower floor: a hotel hallway with a yellow cleaning cart, suitcase and papers, leading to a bright opening at the far end, which is the presumed onward route.
- 'SUITE A' is on the right side of the hallway. Inside are a living area with armchairs (pipe bomb was there), a bedroom left of the suite entry (nightstand where I took the magnum; my old pistol is now there) and a dresser in the living area.

CURRENT STATE (as of last action):
- Just revived by Rochelle at the Suite A dresser. Health 29 (red), low and slow.
- Inventory: magnum in slot 2 (8-round magazine), pipe bomb in slot 3, first aid kit in slot 4. No primary weapon yet.
- Last action: pressed E on a green-glowing item on the dresser (crosshair and reaching hand on it). Unknown whether it was adrenaline, a bile jar or something else; check the inventory or result next.
- Coach was downed shortly before; his status is unknown, so revive him by holding E on him if he is still down.

GOALS:
- Confirm the dresser pickup.
- Help Coach if downed.
- Heal if possible (try longer J holds or rely on bots).
- Find a primary weapon.
- Rejoin the team and continue down the hotel hallway toward the bright opening.

UNCERTAINTIES:
- Exact heal duration required.
- Identity of the green-glowing item.
- Exact exit route beyond the hallway.
